steps.note: S1.2.1 gives rows 0-1 subtracting JA+Rc, rows 2-5 adding R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), rows 6-7 restoring c,a, so the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of a,c, matching the paper.
S1.2.2 states the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero/two already zero, self coefficient one.
S1.2.3 states the complex central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by the side term for intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S1.2.4 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) and S1.2's method has each invocation restore its scratch wires.

The plan only says each edge is given the dimension of its orthogonal residual and that edges join comparable labels (S1.4.1 method, S1.4.1.5); no per-edge residuals or dimensions (the residual table) are stated.

S1.4.1.4 states the inclusion P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥ from t_X ⊥ t_Y (quoting the label construction at line 953), but never the residual of side edge 2->5, the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2, so the defining content is incomplete.
The plan states the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 losing dimension h, sources N and sinks Wm-N, signed telescoping to Wm-2N, and Ic edges of loss h adding 2L for Wm-2N+2L.
S1.4.1.7b states every nonzero F_2 residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating (contains a norm-one unit) hence has an orthonormal basis, with alternating planes absorbed via w+a, w+b, w+a+b.
S1.4.1.7c gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.

S1.4.1.9.2 derives weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors from the wt(z+w) identity, and S1.4.1.9's method/motivation decompose the phase difference q_V-q_U into one phase per orthonormal residual basis vector.
S1.4.1.9.3 states wt(v) odd, the phase i^{ε[v·x]} expanded via (-1)^{v·x}, and H diag(1,-1) H = X turning it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.

S1.4.1.9 gives one kernel per residual basis vector, and S1.4.4.1.4/S1.4.4.1.7 apply each as (C^{ε_h})^{⊗f} across the f columns with s_c such child operations in all, which is the tensored-factor count.

S1.4.4.1.9 asserts the telescoped C^{⊗m} result and mentions C=iZC^{-1}Z fixing 27 inverse factors, but omits the endpoint frames (zero label I, full label C^{⊗m}) and only names the source/sink corrections without Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, so the derivation is not stated.
The plan states both loss ratios are below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.
The plan states both deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, log m<20 so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η), hence s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}.

S1.4.3.1.2 gives the elimination with pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing, deletion and repetition on active indices, and S1.4.3.1.1 gives Π with exactly a ones.

S1.4.3.1.3 states the prime q is chosen avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators so updates use diagonal units over Z/q^b, a compressed but faithful statement (the fixed finite table is not spelled out).
S1.4.3.1.3 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier coordinates.
S1.4.3.1.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j yielding (h+d,d), and S1.4.3.1.5 one interchange per one of Π, a in all.
The plan states E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, B≤m^ν, C_1=max{20,ν+3}=20, the bound 128mB^2 d^{ν+3} ≤ C_0 d^{C_1}, and Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ (ν=11 and C_0's definition left implicit).
S1.4.4.4.1 gives A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E internally, A(e)≤8e at leaves, with E bounding scalar gates 24W^3, child corrections 4s and bank corrections.
The plan unrolls with sx+E≤Bx to A(e)≤8dB^{k+1}, uses B^{k+1}≤B^2 d^ν for A(e)≤8B^2 d^{ν+1}, and bounds the total below C_0 d^{C_1}.
S1.4.4.4.6 gives depth-ℓ values in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] of modulus ≤2^ℓ and the p+Δ fractional / Δ+3 integer bit reservation; S1.4.4.4.7 gives εC_1<1 so Δ=o(p).
S1.4.4.5.3 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, disks are preserved, and truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P08 states 23 of 26 sub-steps. All of bank-exchange-network (B1-B4), rank-saving (R1-R4), matrix-shear (M1-M4) and simultaneous-layer (S1-S5) are present. Absent: L1 (no per-edge residual table), L2 (inclusion stated but not the h-2 complement residual of side edge 2->5), and P4 (endpoint frames I and C^{⊗m} and the Z_{a,k}, i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repairs not stated, only the result plus C=iZC^{-1}Z). No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
